notes.title: Announcing Warbound
notes.notes:
Hey there!

It's been a hot minute hasn't it? 
I'm excited to announce my next upcoming game Warbound, a side scrolling RTS inspired by classics such as Age of War and many others. 

Warbound will take players through various eras from sending hordes of Stone age warriors with slingshots and clubs to Skeleton wars and the far flung future where machines have taken over. 

You have one goal; conquer the opposition at all cost!

Defend yourself with deadly turrets, modernize your base through the ages and devastate the battlefield with barrages of lasers and meteror strikes.

I recently reached vertical slice for the game in the past couple of weeks and I'm working towards getting Warbound ready for a demo build in the near future.

See you soon on the battlefield!
